name: The Torch of Retribution
summary: After The Flame's Casing, Kalaran Windblade asks you to wait while the pieces are joined and the torch is enchanted. The work is a channeling that must not be disturbed.

sections.title: Binding the Pieces
sections.body: With the pieces gathered, Kalaran needs a moment to join them and lay the needed enchantments on the torch. The work is a channeling that must not be interrupted, so you wait while Kalaran casts.

sections.title: When the Wait Ends
sections.body: After a while, the torch appears before Kalaran, who says it is done. Kalaran adds that there is one final matter left for you to see to.

faq.answer: Kalaran Windblade combines the pieces and applies the enchantments, channeling magic to finish the torch.

faq.q: What came right before this step?
faq.answer: The Flame's Casing, in which you found a Symbol of Ragnaros for Kalaran to make into the casing.

faq.q: Why must you not interrupt Kalaran?
faq.answer: Kalaran is channeling, and warns you not to interrupt the process while the pieces are combined.
